reviewMethod: view_image at original size for both source-scale finished field crops and both complete 800x1075 framed poses; compared with previously inspected original source fields and v1 failures

findings.grossColourCuts: The glaring angular white gap in the top right upper arm and white torso wedges from the first draft are resolved. Existing upper-arm and core colour coverage is retained by a secondary default.
findings.primaryLats: Primary follows the existing lateral wing fields down past the earlier mask ends. The source-visible rib/serratus and core remain secondary. Exact field ownership and small edge fringes still require root native judgment.
findings.neutralPectorals: Pectoral fields are neutralized using inherited maximum-channel shading. Natural chest contours remain; this is not exact recovery of an independently retained uncoloured source. Small inherited colour/contour fringes remain at parts of the pectoral boundary and are disclosed for review.
findings.sourceNeutralPixels: All pixels outside original source-chroma coverage and original alpha remain byte-exact at source scale. No anatomical contour, body segment, grip, shoe or neutral equipment pixel was deliberately reshaped.
findings.mechanics: Full elbow-extension suspended hang and chin-clearly-above-bar suspended top remain intact. Both overhand grips visibly contact the bar. Only two static endpoints exist; no intermediate pull, scapular initiation or controlled descent is visually proved.
findings.framing: The common crop is reduced only at its empty top. Both complete figures, trainers, stationary rack uprights/bar and bases remain visible; no extra source scaling was used. Top endpoint has24px padding.
findings.equipmentProvenance: Full rack comes from the original Muscle-Up full-rig master. Generated source files are central bar/whole-athlete outputs. Existing approved whole-output normalization/translation and fixed outer-rig preservation are reproduced, not newly invented equipment.

requiredRemainingGates: Root native acceptance of colour roles, contours, identity/proportions, grips and equipment joins
Actual six-cue endpoint playback review with no intermediate/continuous movement claim
